newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint firms vs dlr, March CHF futures active.
newsitem.headline: Forint firms vs dlr, March CHF futures active.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed a shade firmer against the dollar on Thursday following dollar/mark changes on international markets, dealers said.
The forint closed at 174.52/57 to the U.S. unit, compared to 174.85/95 at opening.
In the afternoon the forint traded some 25 to 30 pips weaker than the central bank's bid, hardly changed from 25 pips in early trading, they said.

On the Commodity Exchange dollar and Swiss francs futures moved lower, with active trading for the latter for March. German mark, yen and Italian lira futures closed mixed, while the sterling levelled.
BCE currency futures turnover totalled 3.33 billion forints.
